newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CSN Q1 net profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CSN Q1 net profit rises.

text.p: Brazilian private steelmaker CSN, or Companhia Siderurgica Nacional, issued the following statement on its first quarter results.
NOTE: All figures in Brazilian reais, not adjusted for inflation. The company said its net profit increased 69 percent compared with the same period of 1996.
Steel production totalled 1.174 million tonnes, up five percent from last year's first quarter.
It said it sold 1.066 million tonnes of finished steel products in the first quarter against 1.086 million tonnes in the same period of 1996.
Net financial revenues rose 16.5 percent to 12 million reais in the first quarter from 10.3 million reais a year ago, it said.
The steelmaker also said it invested 79.9 million reais between January and March.
CSN, along with local pension funds and foreign investors, last week acquired control of mining company CVRD.
